sv.title: Efter katastrofförlusten: Profilerna lämnar Trump
sv.summary: Efter republikanernas katastrof i mellanårsvalet har flera konservativa poddare hållit låg profil. Stjärnan Joe Rogan var en av dem – men nu bryter han tystnaden. – De förlorade inte bara podcastkillarna, de förlorade det mesta av landet, säger han, rapporterar New York Times.

en.title: After the disaster defeat: The pundits leave Trump
en.summary: After the Republicans' disaster in the midterm elections, several conservative podcasters have kept a low profile. Star Joe Rogan was one of them – but now he is breaking his silence. – They didn't just lose the podcast bros, they lost most of the country, he says, reports the New York Times.
